title: Clinton said he didn't think they'd tell him about aliens

tellings.quote:
And then later was President Clinton I
know was interviewed by somebody and
said do you believe that we have signs
of alien life and we've hiding or
there's a program or something and he
basically said, I don't think they tell
me even though I'm the president.

plain: Bill Clinton, the former US president, was once asked in an interview whether the government had signs of alien life or a hidden program, and answered, in effect, that he did not think they would tell him even though he was president. Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, retells this, describing it as something he knows of Clinton saying. It matters because it would suggest such secrets are kept even from the president.
